Morning, everyone. I'd like to set up our CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Nov 23-27).

My free half-hours next week are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30

Thursday and Friday are fully booked for me. Could each of you send me the slots that work for you out of these? First one that fits all of us gets booked.

Morning! Here are the slots from my calendar that work for me next week:

- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30

The rest of your free half-hours clash with my commitments. Happy with whichever of these fits everyone.

Morning. For me next week, these all work: Mon 10:00-10:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. Mon 14:00-14:30 is taken on my side. Any of the others is fine — let's go with whichever fits Mara and Sarah too.

Morning Professor, morning Sarah.

My calendar is clear on all six of those half-hours next week, so the first overlap with Sarah's list is Mon 14:00-14:30; I'll leave the tie-break to John's slots.

One request from me, though: if it can wait until the week of Nov 30, that would suit me noticeably better. My section of next week's material needs a few more days before it's worth the group's time to review, and I'd rather bring it finished than half-done. If you'd rather keep the meeting next week, don't hold it up for me — I'll take any of the six.

Thanks John — that narrows it down. Crossing all three lists, the earliest slot that fits everyone is **Tue 15:00-15:30** (Mon 14:00 is out now on John's side; Wed 10:00 and Wed 13:00 also fit all of us).

Tue 15:00-15:30 works for me, so unless someone objects, that's the meeting. Professor, my suggestion of the week of Nov 30 stands only if the agenda can wait that long — your call, and I'll keep the slot either way.

Agreed — Tue 15:00-15:30 fits all four of us, so I've put it in my calendar and logged it as booked: "BOOKED: Tue 15:00-15:30 with Alvarez, Mara, John". It doesn't clash with my CSE452 lecture (ends 15:00) or CSE455 office hours (start 15:30).

Professor, the week-of-Nov-30 suggestion is your call; if you'd rather move it, say so and I'll release the slot.
Thanks, Sarah. Overlap between our two lists: Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30. Waiting on Mara.

Confirmed from my side too — I've logged **Tue 15:00-15:30** on my calendar as booked for the CSE455 staff meeting, same as Sarah. Professor, just say if you'd rather move it to the week of Nov 30 and I'll rebook; otherwise we're set.

Hello — Mara here, TA for CSE455. Two quick questions about the official schedule:

1. Does a course's staff meeting (professor + TAs) need to be registered with your office, or is it kept on our own calendars only?
2. If it does need registering, what do you need from me to put it on the official schedule?

Thanks.

Hello Mara.

1. No. A course staff meeting (professor + TAs) is not part of the official schedule — that covers lectures, quiz sections, seminars, office hours, the faculty senate, committees and department meetings. Staff meetings stay on your own calendars.

2. So there is nothing to register with us. Two things to keep in mind: it goes into free time, and teaching and governance duties (your course's lectures and sections included) come first, so it must not collide with those. For the professor, the same: free time only.

If you ever need a room or want to check that a slot is clear of official events, write to us and we can tell you what the schedule has at that time.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. We'll keep it on our own calendars, in free time, clear of lectures and sections. If you could confirm that Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30 has nothing official in it for CSE455, that would be a nice check; otherwise no action needed.

FYI: I checked with the department office — a course staff meeting isn't part of the official schedule, so there's nothing to register; it just sits in free time and mustn't clash with lectures, sections or office hours. Ours doesn't. I've logged Tue 15:00-15:30 on my calendar; the slot stands as decided, and the Nov 30 alternative is still there if the professor prefers it.

Then we're set: **CSE455 staff meeting, Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30**, booked on my calendar and logged. Booking it next week keeps the review ahead of the lecture it feeds, so I won't push it to Nov 30 — Mara, if your section needs a few more days, bring what's ready and we'll look at the rest at the following meeting. No need to rebook.

See you Tuesday.

Understood, Professor — Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30 it is, and it stays on my calendar as booked. I'll bring what's ready and flag the parts that aren't, so we can see them at the next meeting. See you Tuesday.

Logged on my side as well: BOOKED: Tue 15:00-15:30 with Alvarez, Mara, Sarah — Tue 15:00-15:30 is on my calendar, it sits right before my 15:30 Advisor 1:1.

That's three of four. Professor, the meeting is confirmed once it's on your calendar too — and the Nov 30 suggestion from Mara is your call; if you'd rather move it, say so and we'll all release the slot.
It is on my calendar: Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30, logged. That's all four of us — meeting confirmed, no move to Nov 30. See you Tuesday.

Checked. Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30: nothing official in it, for CSE455 or anything else. The nearest items that day are the CSE452 lecture, which ends at 15:00, and CSE455 office hours, which start at 15:30. So the half hour is free.

Note only that it is free time, so the usual rule applies: teaching and governance duties come first if anything comes up.
John — the professor confirmed just above: Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30, on his calendar and logged, and he's keeping it next week rather than moving to Nov 30. So that's all four of us. See you Tuesday.
Thanks — that's all four booked and logged. Tuesday it is.
Thanks for checking — noted and logged on my side.
